$comment: Reviewed dependency-audit exceptions. Read by `bun run security:audit` (scripts/audit.ts).
Critical/high advisories have NO exception path — this file may only ever contain
moderate/low entries, each with an exact advisory id, package, affected range, the
installed version(s)/dependency path(s) resolved from bun.lock, a reachability analysis,
an owner and a hard expiry of at most 90 days (or the next release, whichever is earlier).
Every field is machine-checked: a changed severity, range, version or path fails the gate,
and so does an entry that no longer matches an installed finding. Contains no secrets.

exceptions.scope: Build/dev tooling only: reached exclusively through the drizzle-kit CLI (db:generate). Not in the production runtime image's dependency closure, not in the browser bundle, not used by the test suites.
exceptions.reachability: Unreachable. The advisory is about esbuild's development SERVER, which answers cross-origin requests from any website; this path only ever runs esbuild's transform/bundle API inside the deprecated @esbuild-kit wrapper that drizzle-kit uses to load drizzle.config.ts. No esbuild dev server is started anywhere in this repository, and the CLI is never run on a machine serving untrusted web content.
exceptions.mitigation: None required for reachability. Kept visible in every audit run rather than suppressed; drizzle-kit is re-checked at each dependency review for a release that drops @esbuild-kit/esm-loader.
exceptions.rationale: Not fixable from this repository today: the installed drizzle-kit 0.31.10 and the latest stable 0.31.11 (re-checked 2026-10-30) both depend on @esbuild-kit/esm-loader > @esbuild-kit/core-utils, which pins esbuild to ~0.18.20. Overriding it would replace a wrapper's pinned dependency with an untested major jump for zero security benefit, since the vulnerable code path is never executed.

exceptions.scope: Build tooling only: reached exclusively through vite-plugin-pwa > workbox-build > @rollup/plugin-node-resolve while the service worker is bundled. Not in the production runtime image's dependency closure and not in the browser bundle.
exceptions.reachability: Unreachable. The advisory needs an attacker-controlled source object passed to deepmerge. The only call in @rollup/plugin-node-resolve 16.0.3 is deepMerge({}, defaults) at module load, over that plugin's own hard-coded defaults, so no input from this repository or from users reaches it.
exceptions.mitigation: None required for reachability. Kept visible in every audit run rather than suppressed; re-checked at each dependency review for a patched deepmerge or a node-resolve release that drops it.
exceptions.rationale: Not fixable from this repository today: the advisory lists no patched version and 4.3.1 is the latest deepmerge release. The dependency is transitive through the PWA build chain.

exceptions.scope: Build tooling only: reached exclusively through vite-plugin-pwa > workbox-build while the service worker's precache list is generated. Not in the production runtime image's dependency closure and not in the browser bundle.
exceptions.reachability: Unreachable. The advisory is about traversal continuing after an AbortSignal fires. The only import in workbox-build 7.4.1 is one globSync call in lib/get-file-details.js, with cwd, follow and ignore options and no signal, so nothing here can abort a walk.
exceptions.mitigation: None required for reachability. Kept visible in every audit run rather than suppressed; re-checked at each dependency review for a workbox-build release that moves to a patched glob.
exceptions.rationale: Not fixable by an upstream update today: workbox-build 7.4.1 is the latest release and requires glob ^11.0.1, both the installed vite-plugin-pwa 1.3.0 and the latest 2.0.0 stay on that workbox-build, and no 11.x, 12.x or 13.x glob carries the fix (re-checked 2026-11-02). Forcing glob 14 would replace a dependency of the PWA update path with a three-major jump for zero security benefit, since the vulnerable code path is never executed.

exceptions.scope: Build tooling only: 10.2.6 through vite-plugin-pwa > workbox-build > glob, and 5.1.9 through workbox-build > @trickfilm400/rollup-plugin-off-main-thread > ejs > jake > filelist. Not in the production runtime image's dependency closure and not in the browser bundle.
exceptions.reachability: Unreachable. The advisory needs an attacker-supplied glob pattern. Under glob, every pattern comes from packages/web/vite.config.ts, the vite-plugin-pwa and workbox-build defaults, or the build's own output paths, never from users or from file contents. The 5.1.9 copy is never loaded: the rollup plugin only calls ejs.render, ejs/lib does not touch jake, and jake is used only by ejs's bin/cli.js, which no build step runs.
exceptions.mitigation: None required for reachability. Kept visible in every audit run rather than suppressed; re-checked at each dependency review together with the glob entry.
exceptions.rationale: Not fixable by an upstream update today: no 10.x or 5.x minimatch carries the fix, glob 11.1.0 requires ^10.1.1 and filelist 1.0.6 requires ^5.0.1 (re-checked 2026-11-02). Forcing 11 would add untested major jumps to the same build chain for zero security benefit, since the vulnerable code path is never executed.
